review.archive_identity: publisher GitHub asset digest and checksums.sha256 independently match
review.ffmpeg_source_and_build_recipes: included at exact upstream Git commits

source.transitive_source_status: The retained vendor README inventories linked components. A complete corresponding-source archive for all linked dependencies has not been assembled by this application. This lock does not authorize public binary redistribution.

deployment.profile: private personal use and local CI validation
deployment.notes: Obtain this runtime directly from its publisher in an explicit setup/build step or provide the already verified ZIP offline. Keep license and vendor README together with the executables. No model weights, private voices or recordings are included.

current_gyan_full.rights: Keep every original license and documentation file. This installer prepares a private local runtime only; it is not an authorization to redistribute linked GPL components without their corresponding source and notices.

confirmed_user_workflow.finding: Canonical opt-in acquisition was a documented end-user SetupLocalAudio workflow, not only developer build tooling.

evidence.contract: Optional local audio setup tells the user to open SetupLocalAudio.cmd and review/confirm the three pinned inputs.
Installed isolated Python launches the fixed setup helper with --interactive.
Read-only default and explicit YES/--download acquire pinned files and prepare a fresh external folder; no engine activation.

confirmed_user_workflow.audited_current_gap: Manual selected-archive preparation and CI Invoke-WebRequest did not preserve the canonical end-user download route.

restoration.workflow: Root-owned exact main-step hunk is retained in EXPLICIT_AUDIO_ACQUISITION_20261127.json; actual existing main setup must qualify the real download.
restoration.source_review: Independent bounded core and test integration GO; all69 cases and real acquisition remain NOT_RUN.

provenance_and_rights.old_scope: Exact FFmpeg and BtbN build-recipe source archives plus dependency-recipe index were present. Canonical itself declares no complete transitive corresponding-source bundle or public distribution clearance.
provenance_and_rights.current_scope: All45 Gyan original files, fixed archive/member digests, publisher/source URL and commit and license notes. The old BtbN source/recipe archives/index are not included or applicable.
provenance_and_rights.difference: This is an explicit provenance-scope reduction/change; it is not a verified corresponding-source substitute. The fixed-download restoration does not close that separate distribution qualification.

wrappers_and_notices.no_claim: No comtypes implementation was copied; retaining a protocol concept does not imply copied-wrapper provenance or current native execution.

qualification.scope_limit: The broader private installed bundle is not the same tested configuration as the audio-free standard-generation payload. This source map is not a PASS receipt.

native_sapi.original_failure_retained: ecfc source69/2FAIL and installed69/2FAIL; corrected fixtures/factory are documented separately.

version_audit.recommendation: Restore canonical dev2 in both current files. No pin to dev1 was found in the bounded packaging/setup/build owners or main workflow.
version_audit.basis: source_wheel verifies filename/METADATA/dist-info against committed pyproject; builder derives install.lock from the actual wheel. Inno AppVersion uses the source short hash and independent VersionInfoVersion=0.0.0.0. This is not an exhaustive repository grep or an installer run.

limits: No entire obsolete runtime or workflow family is copied merely to restore a filename.
No old PASS is transferred to current binaries, worker protocols, versions or settings.
Private/model tests not actually run remain unqualified.
Source and build provenance differences remain explicit even when a generic license text is byte-identical.

discovery.guards: Invalid explicit/bundled selection refuses instead of silently falling back; current working directory is not searched; discovery itself never executes or downloads.
discovery.limit: A manually selected external executable remains a separate authority from a sealed current bundle. An old BtbN/essentials manifest is not a current full-build admission.
